2. By means of the present
application, the applicant seeks grant of
anticipatory bail in connection with FIR
No. 461 of 2023, registered at Police
Station Bazpur, District Udham Singh
Nagar, for the offences punishable under
Sections 323, 376 and 506 of the Indian
Penal Code.
3. The Coordinate Bench of this
Court, vide order dated 21.11.2023,
granted interim anticipatory bail to the
applicant. In compliance with the
conditions stipulated therein, the
applicant has duly cooperated with the
investigation as and when called upon
by the Investigating Officer.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant
submits that the applicant has also
preferred an application under Section
528 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha
Sanhita, 2023, being C-528 Application
No. 147 of 2026, in which the
Coordinate Bench of this Court, vide
order dated 03.02.2026, stayed the
entire proceedings.
5. Learned counsel for the applicant
further submits that, pursuant to the
interim protection granted by this Court,
the applicant has cooperated throughout

2026:UHC:7321
the investigation and has not misused
the liberty so granted to him. It is further
submitted that the investigation has
culminated in the submission of the
charge-sheet and, therefore, no custodial
interrogation of the applicant is required
at this stage.
6. Having heard learned counsel for
the parties and upon perusal of the
material available on record, this Court
finds that the applicant has remained
protected by virtue of the interim order
dated 21.11.2023 and has duly complied
with the conditions incorporated therein
by extending full cooperation during the
course of investigation. It is also brought
on record that the entire proceedings
arising out of the aforesaid FIR have
been stayed by the Coordinate Bench of
this Court in C-528 Application No. 147
of 2026 and the said order has been
made absolute. No material has been
placed before this Court to indicate that
the applicant has either misused the
liberty granted to him or failed to
cooperate with the investigating agency.
7. Having regard to the facts and
circumstances of the case, the order
passed by the Coordinate Bench in the
proceedings under Section 528 of the
Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita,
2023, the conduct of the applicant
during the period of interim protection,
and without expressing any opinion on
the merits of the case, this Court is of
the considered opinion that the
applicant has made out a case for
confirmation of the interim anticipatory
bail granted vide order dated
21.11.2023.
8. Consequently, the interim
anticipatory bail granted to the applicant
vide order dated 21.11.2023 is hereby
confirmed and made absolute. The
applicant shall remain on anticipatory

as contained in the aforesaid order.
9. Accordingly, the present
Anticipatory Bail Application stands
allowed.
